en: The Triplet of the Wholesome (Kusalattika) and the Couple of Having an Object (Sārammaṇaduka)
Dependent on a wholesome state with an object, a state that is neither wholesome nor with an object arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a wholesome state with an object, a state that is unwholesome but not with an object arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a wholesome state with an object, a state that is neither wholesome nor with an object and neither unwholesome nor with an object [arises]...
And states arise by way of root condition ... [three].
Dependent on an unwholesome state with an object, a state that is neither unwholesome nor with an object arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on an unwholesome state with an object, a state that is not wholesome and not with an object arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on an unwholesome state with an object, there arise states that are neither wholesome nor with an object and neither unwholesome nor with an object by way of root condition... three.
Dependent on an indeterminate state with an object, there arises a state that is neither wholesome nor with an object by way of root condition... three. (Abbreviated.)

With respect to the root condition, there are nine; with respect to the predominance condition, nine … pe … with respect to the mutuality condition, three … pe … with respect to the resultant condition, three … pe … with respect to the non-disappearance condition, nine.
Dependent on an indeterminate (abyākata) state that is without an object (anārammaṇa), arises a state that is neither wholesome nor without an object, by way of the root condition.
Dependent on an indeterminate state that is without an object, arises a state that is neither unwholesome nor without an object, by way of the root condition.

Dependent on an indeterminate (abyākata) state that is without an object (anārammaṇa), there arise states that are neither wholesome nor without an object and neither unwholesome nor without an object, by way of root-condition (hetupaccaya). (Abbreviated.
Under root-condition there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance-condition there are three.
